verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own marketing claims built-in AI: agents that continuously monitor the product, surface insights and recommend next steps (mixpanel-docs-44), AI trend-spotting and summaries across session replays (mixpanel-docs-21, mixpanel-docs-27), and AI-driven 'what changed and why' diagnosis delivered as a dashboard (mixpanel-docs-15). These are homepage claims only, with no documentation of an in-product assistant you can hand tasks to. The MCP server is excluded because it serves external AI assistants rather than being built in. missing for 10: first-party docs describing an in-app assistant and how users delegate tasks to it, the scope of actions it can perform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
